component.title: DataToolbar
component.purpose: Keep collection query, refinement, saved context, freshness, and actions in one responsive, keyboard-operable surface.

states.description: A populated collection can be searched, refined, sorted, and acted upon.
An in-flight refresh preserves context and announces progress.
Saved results remain useful while freshness and recovery are explicit.

elements.description: The collection query and filter form.
Refresh, export, column, and density actions.

claims.statement: The collection query surface has an accessible search name.
Collection actions are exposed through a named toolbar.
Non-idle freshness states expose a live status message.
